title: fix: preserve fenced sections when filtering CLI docs
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16433

- Keeps Markdown sections intact across backtick/tilde fences, so shell comments do not become documentation headings.
- Preserves heading matches and uses body matching as a fallback for routes such as `/v1/models` and `/v1/chat/completions`.
- Adds one parameterized command regression. Existing `models` and `/image` output matches baseline byte for byte.
- Verified: all 286 CLI tests, build and scoped Biome; native checks against the captured canonical reference and six fence controls.

Strict TypeScript diagnostics remain identical to the 36 existing baseline errors. Local tests used the already installed dependency cache.

gist.headline: Keep the fences standing
gist.blurb: Polli CLI keeps fenced code where it belongs: inside the docs, not masquerading as headings. Route lookups can also find endpoints mentioned in a section’s body.
gist.summary: Fixed Polli CLI’s docs filtering to preserve sections across backtick and tilde fences and fall back to body matches for routes such as `/v1/models` and `/v1/chat/completions`, while keeping existing `models` and `/image` output unchanged.
gist.impact: CLI docs searches keep shell comments inside code fences and can find `/v1/models` and `/v1/chat/completions` when those routes appear in section bodies.
gist.visual_concept: Show a cozy CLI terminal with a Markdown document: sturdy backtick and tilde fences contain shell comments, while route labels remain easy to find. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, tends the fences beside a small code-plant.
